description: Deterministic genesis (spec 01.1): the owner keys — root_sign, content_sign, owner_kex — derived from a fixed master seed S. root_sign_pub_ed2x_hex pins the normative Ed25519->X25519 map (spec 01.2). Expected values generated independently (Python: blake3 + PyNaCl + base58) to cross-check the reference implementation. v2: single content key replaces the three sphere keys (spec redline 8f44cab).
